issues.where: the main mountain rock face in the left crop (also visible across the peak in set-B-01.png)
issues.what: blatant low-poly flat facets, hard UV seams, stretched snow patches, and a visibly mirrored texture pattern on the lower right rock surface
issues.fix: rebuild the peak with high-resolution displaced rock geometry, eliminate UV seams and mirroring, and blend snow naturally into crevices

issues.where: the translucent purple-grey streamers trailing right from the ridge (and in set-B-02.png top-right crop)
issues.what: the streamers read as flat, papery CG ribbon meshes with jagged, aliased thin white tether lines rather than physical vapour or organic membranes
issues.fix: replace the flat ribbon strips with volumetric simulation or physically shaded translucent membranes with soft edges and natural thickness

issues.where: the cave walls in the top-left, top-right, and bottom-left crops (also visible across set-B-04.png)
issues.what: rock texture is heavily stretched, blurry, and smeared over a smooth curved tunnel surface with polygonal silhouette edges at the cave opening
issues.fix: add real multi-scale rock displacement and sharp high-resolution triplanar or non-stretched textures, and break up the cave mouth silhouette

issues.where: the distant mountains outside the cave mouth in the right crop (also visible through the opening in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the peaks are flat, untextured uniform grey polygons with razor-straight geometric edges and no surface relief or layered aerial perspective
issues.fix: give the distant peaks real silhouette crags, subtle rock and snow detail, and graded atmospheric haze

issues.where: the foreground creature's fur in the bottom-right crop (and the walking creature's coat in set-B-06.png left crop and set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the fur visibly reads as stiff, flat alpha-masked hair cards with harsh jagged cutout edges intersecting at rigid angles
issues.fix: use higher-density strand-based fur or finer, softer layered clumps with natural gravity, snow dusting, and anti-aliased alpha edges

issues.where: the lightning strike at the summit tip and the upper ridge below it
issues.what: the bolt creates only a tiny localized bright spot and fails to cast intense purple-white light, bounce, or atmospheric bloom across the rock face and nearby clouds
issues.fix: drive strong local illumination and bloom from the lightning bolt onto the upper peak, streamers, and surrounding storm clouds

issues.where: the hanging icicles in the top-right crop (also visible across the cave ceiling in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the icicles look like thin, opaque grey geometric cones stuck onto the rock with no internal ice refraction, specular highlights, or frozen base transition
issues.fix: shade the icicles with translucent refractive ice, varied thickness, wet specular highlights, and ice crusts where they meet the ceiling

issues.where: the cluster of small rounded creatures along the ridge in the top-right crop
issues.what: they look like smooth low-poly pebbles with no contact shadows, and a small piece floats detached above the cluster
issues.fix: ground every creature onto the rock with contact occlusion and add surface detail and weather matching the ridge

issues.where: the snow bank in the right crop and the snow-to-wall edge in the left crop
issues.what: the snow reads as a smooth plastic-like undulating mesh with soft featureless shading and a hard straight intersection against the cave wall
issues.fix: add wind-sculpted snow micro-detail, subsurface scattering, and drifted accumulation where the snow meets the rock wall

issues.where: the walking creature's feet and lower legs on the icy cave floor
issues.what: no footprints, disturbed frost, or wet/snowy matting on the lower fur, and the contact shadow looks soft and ungrounded against the glossy ice
issues.fix: add sharp contact occlusion under each foot, tracks or frost disturbance on the ice, and packed snow and dampness on the lower fur

issues.where: the horizon line in the right crop (also visible on the right of set-B-01.png)
issues.what: the boundary between the orange sunset band and the dark cloud sea is an unnaturally razor-straight horizontal line
issues.fix: soften the horizon with atmospheric haze and uneven distant cloud tops
